items.name: vCLS-b6adfa74-6ad3-468d-9ca9-03797153f445
items.owner: vSphere Cluster Service VM is deployed from an OVA with a minimal installed profile of PhotonOS. vSphere Cluster Service manages the resources, power state and availability of these VMs. vSphere Cluster Service VMs are required for maintaining the health and availability of vSphere Cluster Service. Any impact on the power state or resources of these VMs might degrade the health of the vSphere Cluster Service and cause vSphere DRS to cease operation for the cluster.

Tier 0 – Foundation.config: CDP / continuous replication, immutability on-prem + cloud, highest VRO runbook priority

Tier 1 – Platinum.config: Near-CDP replication + immutable backup, automated VRO orchestration plan with failover

Tier 2 – Gold.config: Multiple daily backups + optional replication, semi-automated VRO runbook

Tier 3 – Silver.config: Daily backup, immutability optional, standardized VRO runbook

Tier 4 – Bronze.config: Standard backup policy (daily/weekly), manual recovery acceptable
